rules.title: Prohibited inquiries of housing applicants (M.G.L. c. 151B, s. 4(6)(c))
rules.requirement: Owners, lessees, brokers, managing agents and others with the right to rent covered housing accommodations may not make or cause to be made any written or oral inquiry or record about the race, religious creed, color, national origin, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, genetic information, ancestry, marital status, veteran or armed forces status, or handicap of a person seeking to rent, lease or buy.
rules.coverage_text: Owners, lessees, sublessees, licensed real estate brokers, assignees or managing agents of publicly assisted or multiple dwelling or contiguously located housing accommodations, other persons with the right to rent, lease or sell them, their agents or employees, and condominium or housing cooperative unit-owner organizations.
rules.exemptions: The word 'age' does not apply to minors, to residency in state-aided or federally-aided housing developments for the elderly, to residency in federal low income housing tax credit developments intended for persons 55 or over or 62 or over, or to residency in communities built expressly for persons 55 or over or 62 or over if the owner or manager registers biennially with the executive office of housing and livable communities.
rules.quoted_span: (c) to cause to be made any written or oral inquiry or record concerning the race, religious creed, color, national origin, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, which shall not include persons whose sexual orientation involves minor children as the sex object, age, genetic information, ancestry or marital status of the person seeking to rent or lease or buy any such accommodation, or concerning the fact that such person is a veteran or a member of the armed forces or because such person is blind or hearing impaired or has any other handicap.

rules.title: Refusal to rent based on protected class (M.G.L. c. 151B, s. 4(6)(a))
rules.requirement: Owners and others with the right to rent covered housing accommodations may not refuse to rent or lease, or otherwise deny or withhold accommodations from, any person because of race, religious creed, color, national origin, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, genetic information, ancestry, marital status, veteran or armed forces status, blindness, hearing impairment or other handicap.
rules.coverage_text: Owners, lessees, sublessees, licensed real estate brokers, assignees or managing agents of publicly assisted or multiple dwelling or contiguously located housing accommodations, other persons with the right to rent, lease or sell them, their agents or employees, and condominium or housing cooperative unit-owner organizations.
rules.exemptions: The word 'age' does not apply to minors, to residency in state-aided or federally-aided housing developments for the elderly, to residency in federal low income housing tax credit developments intended for persons 55 or over or 62 or over, or to residency in communities built expressly for persons 55 or over or 62 or over if the owner or manager registers biennially with the executive office of housing and livable communities.
rules.quoted_span: (a) to refuse to rent or lease or sell or negotiate for sale or otherwise to deny to or withhold from any person or group of persons such accommodations because of the race, religious creed, color, national origin, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, which shall not include persons whose sexual orientation involves minor children as the sex object, age, genetic information, ancestry, or marital status of such person or persons or because such person is a veteran or member of the armed forces, or because such person is blind, or hearing impaired or has any other handicap;
